title: Registered Pharmacist
description:
Job Title: Registered Pharmacist

Position Summary

The Registered Pharmacist is responsible for providing pharmaceutical care by ensuring the safe and effective use of medications. This role includes accurately dispensing prescriptions, counseling patients on medication use, collaborating with healthcare providers, and supporting patient wellness through clinical and community pharmacy services.

Responsibilities

  • Dispense prescriptions accurately and efficiently in accordance with physician orders and pharmacy regulations
  • Counsel patients regarding medication usage, dosage instructions, side effects, and potential drug interactions
  • Collaborate with physicians and healthcare professionals to optimize medication therapy and patient outcomes
  • Maintain accurate prescription records and patient profiles while ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory standards
  • Conduct health screenings and administer immunizations as needed
  • Participate in community health and wellness initiatives
  • Monitor medication safety and support quality assurance standards within the pharmacy
  • Stay current with new medications, therapies, and pharmaceutical advancements
  • Provide medication education and support to patients and pharmacy staff

Qualifications

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) degree from an accredited institution required
  • Active Registered Pharmacist license in the applicable state required
  • Previous retail or clinical pharmacy experience preferred
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and patient counseling skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Knowledge of pharmacy software systems and pharmacy operations preferred
  • Commitment to professional development and ethical pharmacy practice

Skills:

  • Pharmaceutical care, Medication therapy management, Drug utilization review, Patient counseling, Compounding, Inventory management, Regulatory compliance, Clinical research, Drug interaction assessment, Prescription verification (Desired)

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree - Pharmacy (Desired)
  • Associate’s Degree - Pharma D (Desired)
  • High School Diploma (Required)

title: Nurse Practitioner (NP)
description:
Job Title: Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP)

Position Summary

The Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) provides comprehensive primary care services to diverse patient populations, including adult and geriatric patients, in a collaborative and patient-centered environment. This role focuses on preventive care, chronic disease management, patient education, and delivering high-quality clinical care to support positive patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Provide primary care services including preventive, acute, and chronic care management
  • Assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of medical conditions
  • Manage chronic diseases and pain management treatment plans
  • Educate patients on wellness, disease prevention, and healthy lifestyle practices
  • Collaborate with physicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams to ensure quality patient care
  • Maintain accurate and timely patient documentation and medical records
  • Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as needed

Qualifications

  • Active Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) license required
  • Active DEA license required
  • Previous experience in primary care or related clinical setting preferred
  • Strong clinical judgment and patient-centered approach to care
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a healthcare team

Compensation

  • Compensation commensurate with experience

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics.

Skills:

  • Medical Software Proficiency (Desired)
  • Medical Team Collaboration (Required - 2 years)
  • Chronic Disease Management (Required - 2 years)
  • Patient Assessment (Required - 2 years)
  • Patient Education (Required - 2 years)
  • Advanced Life Support (Desired)
  • Prescription Medication Administration (Required - 2 years)
  • Disease Prevention (Desired)
  • Emergency Medicine (Desired)
  • Health Promotion (Desired)

title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)
description:
Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to provide high-quality hands-on nursing care for patients with diverse medical needs. The LPN will deliver essential clinical support through monitoring vital signs, administering medications, assisting with procedures, and ensuring patient comfort and safety. This role involves close collaboration with registered nurses, physicians, and care teams to promote optimal patient outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide direct nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent, or disabled patients.
  • Monitor patient health status, identify changes, and report findings promptly.
  • Assist RNs and physicians during examinations, treatments, and procedures.
  • Educate patients and families on disease management, nutrition, and health conditions.
  • Administer prescribed medications and IV fluids as directed, documenting all interventions accurately.
  • Perform basic nursing procedures such as wound care, catheterization, temperature and blood pressure monitoring, dressing changes, and hygiene support.
  • Observe, chart, and report any reactions or changes in patient condition.
  • Promote patient safety, comfort, and well-being throughout care delivery.

Qualifications:

  • Active and unrestricted LPN license.
  • Completion of an approved practical nursing program.
  • Strong communication, assessment, and patient-care skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced clinical environments.
  • Compassionate, dependable, and able to work both independently and within a team.
  • Physically able to perform essential job functions, including lifting and assisting patients.
